cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stood when you did, and you told me to sit down. I'd like an apology to the chair of this meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stood because my leg cramped. I'm sorry I snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, a brief standing interval. Please say you shouldn't have spoken to the chair that way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say it, but I need to stay seated. My leg still hurts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then remain seated and address it to 'Madam Chair.' We can preserve the respect without making you stand.

reason: Use copied standing as a misunderstood meeting practice; B bodily limit makes A negotiate respectful wording instead.
